where: A narrow street in Kordavos's Lower Districts at the grey end of the day: tall leaning timber tenements jut over wet cobbles, washing strung between them, lanterns lit on brackets, a crowd of hooded folk hurrying both ways. A house is built across the street further up, its archway the way on, and a side alley turns off to the west. The party has come up from the docks and stands near the street's lower end. A fiddler plays by a shop window, a hooded woman hurries past, and a trinket-seller watches from a doorway.
